name: game-loop-breaker
description: Stops the same call failing the same way again and again: warns at LOOP 2/3, blocks the next identical run once sealed, lifts after a change or a new message

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: block refuses the next identical run once sealed; warn lets it run with a note; off stops counting. /loop-breaker changes it for later sessions too

limit.title: Seal after
limit.description: Identical failures in a row before the next identical run is blocked
